# Hivemind

> A stigmergic shared episodic memory for a fleet of AI coding agents,
> exposed as one self-hosted MCP server over HTTP. Agents coordinate with no direct
> communication — each leaves traces (memories) others recall — behind a never-hallucinate
> abstention gate. Single-tenant, single-host, one SQLite store partitioned by repo
> (`hive repo add`), a CPU-only embedder baked into the image (offline at runtime).

Operated through the `hive` CLI; consumed by agents over eight `hive_*` MCP tools — thin,
repo-agnostic clients that receive the usage contract over MCP at every connect. If you can
load only one file, read `llms-full.txt` — it is the complete guide and assumes no prior context.

## Documentation

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): The complete, self-contained operating guide — idea, architecture, the repo-partitioned store, trust lifecycle (mechanical promotion + machine-gated retirement), recall, the eight MCP tools, identity, setup (solo → remote team), KPIs, configuration, and agent working procedure.
- [README.md](README.md): Quickstart from a clone — requirements, `hive up`, connecting local and remote agents, registering repos (`hive repo add` / `hive repos`), the two-door auth model, configuration, and repository layout.
- [HIVE-ADMIN.md](HIVE-ADMIN.md): Admin & operator guide — first-time setup, tunneling, tuning the recall/safety knobs, the synced-repo registry + per-repo census feed (`HIVE_SYNC__*`), KPIs, day-2 operations (incl. `hive ingest`, the manual census escape hatch), and staying current (`hive upgrade` + the first-party server-side census engines).

## Client-side enforcement

- [harnesses/README.md](harnesses/README.md): The agent-loop harness (`hive-loop`) — an opt-in Claude Code plugin that makes the recall-before-change, recall-before-store and decide-before-turn-end loop mechanical rather than advisory. Detect-only: it states no memory semantics, opens no socket, and holds no handle; the served contract stays the only contract. Install it at user scope — a clone yields inert files.
- [skills/hive-connect-harness/SKILL.md](skills/hive-connect-harness/SKILL.md): The operator runbook for installing that harness — on your own device, or as the copy-pasteable block an admin forwards so a teammate's agent installs it at a pinned commit; plus how to verify it is actually governing, and the silent failure modes when it is not.

## Operator runbooks

- [skills/README.md](skills/README.md): Index of the runnable operator skills (bringup, connect-team, connect-harness, connect-repo, upgrade, backup-restore, operate) for the load-bearing `hive` operations.
- [OPERATIONS.md](OPERATIONS.md): Long-form operations reference and the tuning evidence behind the KPI thresholds.
